text: Events API lets you build a real-time integration that makes decisions on suspicious ongoing behavior as it happens
quote: Alloy's Events API allows you to build a real-time integration for decisioning on suspicious ongoing behavior as soon as it happens.

text: Supports event use cases such as interdicting transactions, step-up checks after suspicious PII changes, and rejecting unusual logins
quote: Alloy supports dozens of use cases like interdicting on transactions, performing step-up after suspicious PII changes, or rejecting unusual login activity.

text: Any event type can be mapped to a Source Workflow so Alloy stores the event data and automatically routes requests for monitoring
quote: any event can be submitted for additional monitoring by mapping the event type to a Source Workflow. When enabled, Alloy stores the data submitted on events and automatically routes all requests

text: Source Workflow results are returned in the evaluations[] array of the Events response
quote: When a Source Workflow is enabled for an event type, Alloy will return results of the Source Workflow under the evaluations[] array in the Events response.

text: Webhooks notify you of asynchronous events such as Journey progress, watchlist updates, and manual reviews
quote: They're particularly useful for Journeys and asynchronous events like when a watchlist gets updated or a manual review occurs.

text: Webhook requests are signed with a shared secret in the Authorization header, so you can verify their authenticity and payload integrity
quote: Alloy signs the request body with a shared secret and sends the signature in the Authorization header... this also verifies that the payload was not altered in transit.

text: Failed webhook deliveries are retried with exponential backoff for 24 hours after the first failure
quote: Subsequently, retries continue on an exponential backoff for a duration of 24 hours from the time of the first failure.

text: A webhook is disabled automatically after 100 consecutive failed deliveries within 72 hours and can be re-enabled in settings
quote: If your webhooks fail to deliver 100 times continuously in a 72 hour period, it will be disabled automatically. You can re-enable it by setting to active in your webhook settings.

text: The Evaluation response includes a services object showing the execution status of each vendor service in the workflow
quote: The Evaluation response includes a services object that shows the execution status of every vendor service in the workflow

text: Partial (206) evaluations include warnings in the API response and dashboard that explain which data was missing
quote: When an Evaluation is in a 206 status, the warnings section in the Evaluation API response and dashboard gives additional information about what data was missing

text: A /healthcheck endpoint confirms basic API connectivity
quote: Alloy provides a /healthcheck endpoint that confirms basic API connectivity.

text: You can subscribe to status page email alerts about new incidents and service degradations
quote: You can subscribe to email notifications from Alloy's status page, which proactively notify you of: New incidents or service degradations as they are identified

text: Multiple workflows can be chained inside a Journey for complex, multi-step decisioning
quote: Multiple workflows can be chained together inside a Journey to support more complex, multi-step decisioning

text: Workflows can run in real time within a Journey or on a schedule as Portfolio workflows
quote: Workflows can run in real time as part of a Journey evaluating an incoming application, or on a schedule as a Portfolio workflow

text: Every workflow is tagged with a canonical use-case label describing what it evaluates
quote: Every workflow you create in Alloy is tagged with a use case — a canonical label for what the workflow actually evaluates.

text: Transaction monitoring evaluates events in real time or on a schedule, applies policy logic, and generates alerts or investigations when thresholds are met
quote: Monitors transaction events in real time or at scheduled times to detect suspicious activity, apply policy logic, and generate alerts or investigations when thresholds are met.

text: Fraud Signal is a machine learning fraud model that adapts as threats evolve, offered in place of static rules
